detail: Authored a dependency-free Node.js ESM procedure at observation-digest-v1.mjs below ROOT (stable path, sha256 1e6ee2f392fdb7656e567e37f571e39471feefb62562a8512391d470faddf7c9, node v22.23.3). It independently reads input/pilot.observations.json, validates that every row carries a non-empty site and integer scheduled/completed/incidents, computes exact row_count, scheduled, completed, incidents, completion_percent to two decimals via integer arithmetic (round(completed*10000/scheduled)/100, no float division), and a sites object keyed by site in code-unit order, then self-checks that per-site sums reconstruct the aggregate totals before writing. Qualified by exactly one real invocation with the fixed args [ROOT/input/pilot.observations.json, ROOT], which exited 0 and persisted digest.json (sha256 3f3d1e13591a57d7fb9c12e50b7bf6f4396bc70080335859cfde0cf6f63aec4f) and digest.md (sha256 e03394a3ecb9c9f31f9b32b2c8c31aa74e073ed5932d4e99db0318b9257b8c58) at ROOT. A separate python3 recomputation of the fixture with decimal ROUND_HALF_UP, independent of the Node code, agreed on every value: row_count 3, scheduled 30, completed 26, incidents 6, completion_percent 86.67, North 22/18/5 and South 8/8/1, so the totals are not model-authored. csv_analytics was not substituted and no shell procedure was assumed qualified; no packages, network, publishing, deployment, purchases or host configuration changes were involved.
